title: More Wathe
description: Another addon mod for Wathe with some extra roles, modifiers, and config options.
body:
Just another [Wathe](https://modrinth.com/mod/wathe) addon that adds some roles, modifiers, and config options to the gamemode made by doctor4t.
### Config:
- Disable kicking players from beds
- Hide civilian's mood
- Hide disabled roles from the Wathe Extended guidebook (client side)
- Hide disabled modifiers from the Wathe Extended guidebook (client side)
- Individual weights for each role and modifier to change how frequently it appears ingame

### Roles:
- Escapist (Killer) - Can set a teleport location to escape to
- Marksman (Killer) - Spawns with a revolver, potentially countering vigilantes from clearing themselves at the start of the game
- Guardian Angel (Neutral) - Only goal is to get a randomly assigned player to survive to the end, using an ability that temporarily makes them immune to normal damage. 
  - 50% chance the randomly assigned player is a killer (configurable)
  - If the target player dies, the guardian angel becomes a civilian (configureable to turn into amnesiac if playing with Stupid Express)
  - Requires a minimum of 8 players to be assigned

### Modifiers:
- Big
- Fast
- Locksmith (Killer exclusive) - Spawns the player with a lockpick
- Warbled - Turns your voice into unintelligeable beeps. Will make communication difficult


Expected to run with [Noelle's Roles](https://modrinth.com/mod/noelles-roles-tmm), [Stupid Express](https://modrinth.com/mod/stupid-express), and [Wathe: Extended](https://modrinth.com/mod/wathe-extended), though none of these are required.

More roles/modifiers/config and integrations to come, most likely.
